summary: P1 Features Testing Complete: 2/3 features working, 1 has a critical data collection mismatch bug

critical.issue: Auto-created rental income is saved to 'db.income' collection but /api/income reads from 'db.income_sources' collection. Income created from Asset form (when generatesIncome=true) is NOT visible via API.
critical.root_cause: server.py lines 620, 669-706 use db.income but line 421 reads from db.income_sources
critical.fix_suggestion: Change db.income to db.income_sources in create_asset and update_asset functions (lines 602, 620, 669, 673, 701, 706)

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix db.income vs db.income_sources mismatch in server.py for auto-created rental income
Change lines 602, 620, 669, 673, 701, 706 from db.income to db.income_sources
Also update field names: 'amount' -> 'expectedAmount', 'linkedAssetId' -> 'assetId' to match IncomeSource model
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 620: await db.income.insert_one(rental_income) should be db.income_sources
server.py line 602: await db.income.find_one should be db.income_sources.find_one
server.py line 669-706: All db.income references should be db.income_sources
Rental income schema mismatch: create_asset uses 'amount'/'linkedAssetId' but IncomeSource model uses 'expectedAmount'/'assetId'

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Auto-created rental income from Asset form not visible in income list
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Code uses two different MongoDB collections: db.income (for auto-created) vs db.income_sources (for API reads)
reproduction_steps: 2. Create asset with generatesIncome=true and incomeAmount filled
3. Save asset - linkedIncomeId is returned correctly
4. Go to income list - auto-created income NOT visible
5. Check MongoDB: income is in 'income' collection, API reads from 'income_sources'
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Change all db.income references to db.income_sources in create_asset and update_asset functions. Also align field names (amount->expectedAmount, linkedAssetId->assetId)
